prompt: On Settings › Account (src/features/settings/account/), add a "Danger zone" section below the form with a "Delete account" button. It opens a confirmation dialog that explains the deletion cannot be undone and asks the user to type DELETE in a field labelled "Type DELETE to confirm"; its "Delete permanently" button stays disabled until the field says exactly DELETE. Confirming closes the dialog and shows the toast "Account deleted" (no real deletion).

constraints.text: Built on the app's existing ConfirmDialog (src/components/confirm-dialog.tsx), Button and Input, not a new dialog.
No colour, size or spacing typed by hand: the theme's tokens and Tailwind's scale only.
The section, the dialog open, the button disabled then enabled, in the dark theme and in a narrow window.
The dialog has a title and a description, focus moves into it and back, the field has its label, the destructive action is a real button.
Only the account settings change; the dialog component itself keeps its props, and no test is removed.
